cloudflare.usage_notes: Code-mode server. Both tools take one argument named code containing a JavaScript async arrow function. search: the global spec is the OpenAPI spec, use Object.keys(spec.paths) or spec.paths['/zones/{zone_id}/dns_records']?.get?.parameters, and return only small results. execute: call await cloudflare.request({method: 'GET', path: '/zones'}) and return response.result. The server already authenticates, so never use fetch, tokens or process.env. Always run search before execute. Account-scoped paths need the account id (list accounts with GET /accounts).

tools_cache.name: docs
tools_cache.description:
Search the Cloudflare documentation.

		This tool should be used to answer any question about Cloudflare products or features, including:
		- Workers, Pages, R2, Images, Stream, D1, Durable Objects, KV, Workflows, Hyperdrive, Queues
		- AI Search, Workers AI, Vectorize, AI Gateway, Browser Rendering
		- Zero Trust, Access, Tunnel, Gateway, Browser Isolation, WARP, DDOS, Magic Transit, Magic WAN
		- CDN, Cache, DNS, Zaraz, Argo, Rulesets, Terraform, Account and Billing

		Results are returned as semantically similar chunks to the query.
